channel.title: Home | Data Center Frontier
channel.description: Data Center Frontier reports on issues related to telecom, data centers, cloud computing, and the future of the internet for those working in facilities powering the cloud.

item.title: NVIDIA's DSX POD Pushes AI Factory Construction Toward the Assembly Line
item.description: As NVIDIA targets two-week deployment of factory-integrated Vera Rubin infrastructure, announcements from Armada, Crusoe, Schneider Electric, Vertiv and other partners reveal the manufacturing capacity, engineering changes and real-world projects behind the industry's shift toward industrialized AI data center construction.
item.author: Matt Vincent
item.media:description: NVIDIA's DSX POD reference design packages Vera Rubin computing, networking, rack-level power and liquid cooling into factory-integrated modular containers, with partner deployments targeted for early 2027. (Rendering: NVIDIA)

item.title: Big Tech's Next Nuclear Bet: More Power From Reactors Already Running
item.description: Google, Amazon and Meta are backing billions in upgrades to existing U.S. nuclear plants, creating a new model for adding generating capacity as AI data center demand accelerates. But engineering timelines and grid constraints remain formidable obstacles.
item.author: David Chernicoff
